```{r}
require(tidyverse)
require(openxlsx)
require(jsonlite)
require(officer)
require(ggpubr)
require(IRdisplay)
require(data.table)
require(lubridate)
require(repr)
require(tictoc)
```

```{r}
ts <- Sys.time()  %>% 
    as.character() %>% 
    str_remove_all(., "[-:]*") %>% 
    str_replace(.," ", "_")
ts
```

```{r}
# exclude(unnecessary WARDs & SECTIONs & vit categories)
ex_wards <- c("集中治療部", "Ｃ/ＨＣＵ", "ＣＣＵ", "ＥＳＩＣＵ", "ＳＣＵ", "ＮＩＣＵ", "ＧＣＵ")
ex_sects <- c("循環器内科", "心臓血管外科", "呼吸器内科", "初期診療・救急科", "呼吸器外科", "小児科", "小児外科", "ＮＩＣＵ", "未熟児センタ", "救急部", "脳神経外科")
ex_categ <- c("SPO2", "HEART_RATE")

setting_list <- list()
setting_list$ex_wards <- ex_wards
setting_list$ex_sects <- ex_sects
setting_list$ex_categ <- ex_categ

f_setting <- c("./dat/setting_", ts, ".rds") %>% 
  str_c(collapse = "")
saveRDS(setting_list, f_setting)
```

```{r}
f_in <- "./dat/admtc_20240329_075221.rds"

df_admtc_org <- readRDS(f_in)

f2_in <- "./dat/vit_20240329_075221.rds"

df_vit_org <- readRDS(f2_in)



```

```{r}
df_admtc <- df_admtc_org %>% 
  filter(!SECTION %in% ex_sects) %>% 
  filter(!WARD %in% ex_wards)

df_vit <- df_vit_org %>% 
  filter(!SECTION %in% ex_sects) %>% 
  filter(!WARD %in% ex_wards)
```

```{r}
f_out <- f_in %>% 
  str_replace("admtc","ir_admtc")

f2_out <- f2_in %>% 
  str_replace("vit","ir_vit")

saveRDS(df_admtc, f_out)
f_out

saveRDS(df_vit, f2_out)
f2_out
```

> f_out
[1] "./dat/ir_admtc_20240329_075221.rds"
> 
> saveRDS(df_vit, f2_out)
> f2_out
[1] "./dat/ir_vit_20240329_075221.rds"
